inlines.v: INCORPORA'TION, noun The act of incorporating. 1. Union of different ingredients in one mass. 2. Association in the same political body; as the incorporation of conquered countries into the Roman republic. 3. Formation of a legal or political body by the union of individuals, constituting and artificial person.
